claims.text: The FDA label reports that some patients reversed triglyceride elevation while continuing isotretinoin through weight reduction and restriction of dietary fat and alcohol, or through dose reduction.
claims.quote: Some patients have been able to reverse triglyceride elevation by reduction in weight and restriction of dietary fat and alcohol while continuing Isotretinoin Capsules or through dosage reduction.

headline.text: The FDA label reports triglyceride improvement with combined dietary and alcohol restriction during isotretinoin treatment.

reported.text: The report does not isolate alcohol restriction from weight loss or dietary fat restriction.

gaps.text: The packet contains no controlled human alcohol-isotretinoin interaction study.
searched: (ethanol[tiab] OR alcohol[tiab]) AND "isotretinoin"[tiab] AND (interaction OR coadministration)
